title: Utility field service: substation inspection
summary: A lineworker's inspection of a distribution substation: site sign, power transformer, and a breaker that is found tripped on the second pass. Field service with no building at all.
style: Unedited first-person snapshot from a head-mounted wearable camera at eye level, deep focus with everything sharp, no bokeh, outdoors at an electrical utility substation, slightly off-level framing, overcast daylight, gravel ground, chain-link fence, light sensor noise, realistic, no people or faces in frame.

shots.prompt: A white sign mounted on a chain-link fence gate reads "NORTHLAKE SUBSTATION" in large red letters, with high-voltage equipment behind the fence.
Side of a large green oil-filled power transformer with cooling fins and an analog oil temperature gauge; a big white stenciled marking on the tank reads "T2".
Open door of an outdoor gray circuit breaker control cabinet; a large engraved label reads "CB-12"; a mechanical position indicator flag shows "CLOSED" in red and a counter.
Open door of an outdoor gray circuit breaker control cabinet; a large engraved label reads "CB-12"; a yellow alarm light is lit and a flag indicator reads "TRIPPED".
